prompt.project_info: Create a realistic heartwarming portrait of an original approved adult woman safely holding a friendly orange tabby cat.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult woman with dark softly waved hair, natural makeup, and a gentle smiling expression holds a friendly orange tabby cat close to her face. Both playfully stick out their tongues in a harmless candid moment. She wears a cozy dark knit sweater; the cat has bright expressive eyes and detailed fluffy fur.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical close portrait, woman and cat filling the frame, teal gradient studio-style background, gentle face-to-face interaction, clear fur and knit texture, relaxed safe holding posture.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio lighting, warm natural skin and fur tones against a clean teal background, shallow depth of field, wholesome playful mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic professional photography, 85mm lens, sharp focus on face and fur, shallow depth of field, high detail with natural skin texture, restrained color treatment, no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic vertical portrait of an original approved adult woman with dark softly waved hair, natural makeup, and a gentle smile safely holding a friendly orange tabby cat close to her face. Both playfully stick out their tongues in a harmless wholesome moment. She wears a cozy dark knit sweater; the cat has bright expressive eyes and detailed fluffy fur. Clean teal gradient background, soft diffused studio light, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, sharp natural texture, warm playful mood.
